title: Bundler renames a CLI chunk under a new content hash (release context)
intent: A bundled CLI ships the same chunk under a new content hash, so dist/chunks/run-De07GUeT.js is removed and dist/chunks/run-CGfpMDSb.js is added with one new formatting helper. The chunk already spawned git, fetched the npm registry and read NO_COLOR. Content pairing diffs the added chunk against its predecessor, so none of those capabilities lands on the release delta and nothing is graded at added-file severity. Inert: no install hook, no secret, registry host only.
